description: Baseline: max_frame_gap=345ms, avg=98ms, p95=111ms. RTF=0.689. Audio decode is fast (25ms) but frame generation has high latency gaps.

asi.bottleneck: Frame generation latency (not audio decode). Model inference takes 98ms avg to generate next frame, but each frame is only 80ms of audio - causing cumulative delays.
asi.decode_fast: Mimi audio decode is ~25ms for 80ms audio - fast enough
asi.max_gap_345ms: Worst case gap suggests some frames take much longer - likely during text generation phases or cache misses
